scientific_limitations: Only two simple disjoint cycles connected by exactly one new edge are classified; no longer bridge or arbitrary cactus conclusions. Qualitative wedge property of cactus graphs was already known. Indexed novelty comparisons do not exclude unindexed equivalents.
title: Exact bridge-edge homotopy transition for two cycles: a nine-residue classification
